lines.en: I find myself walking home after yet another uneventful day at[school].
And I say ‘uneventful’ in the loosest possible sense because Yumi actually showed up today, and that’s always something to celebrate.
Well, it’s something to celebrate when I’m not forcing her to stop insulting the other girls in order to make up for her...apparent inferiority complex?
Now that I think of it, I don’t really understand why Yumi is so mean to everyone to begin with.
It has to be an inferiority complex, right? That’s normally how the bully trope goes.
And God forbid these girls start subverting their character tropes. That would really throw me off.
: Hey! Tall guy! Over here!
: Tall guy?
: Yo!
: Why are you suddenly calling me “tall guy?”
: Huh? Cause you’re tall and you’re a guy. I thought it was pretty obvious.
: Well...I mean, yes. But you’ve never called me that before. It makes it sound like we don’t know each other.
: Who cares? The only other person around is Sana and I’m pretty sure she knows that we’re cool.
Once Rin points that out, I realize that the streets are eerily empty today. I wonder if it’s because of the heat?
No, that can’t be it. Both of them are wearing long sleeves.
Where the hell is everyone?
: Well, either way, go back to calling me Sensei. I don’t want to be “tall guy” anymore.
: It’s bad enough that Kaori is already calling me Hamburger Man. Another nickname would be too much to keep track of.
: Um...isn’t...there already a real Hamburger Man?
: A...real Hamburger Man?...
: Are you talking about the one from that fast food chain? The clown dude?
: Yeah. Isn’t he called...the Hamburger Man?
: Uh...no.
: He’s got like, an actual name. I just don’t think we’re allowed to say it on-screen because of copyright stuff.
: Oh...well, um...
: I think...I’m going to keep calling him the Hamburger Man anyway...
: Two hamburger people is too many...I think Sensei should change.
I am tired of being a hamburger-person. Take me out of this isekai right now.
: Are you sure? You can be Tall Guy and Sana can be Short Girl. You’ll be like a superhero duo.
: Um...what would that make you then, Rin?...
: Uhh, I don’t know?...Average-height Lass?
: That’s...not a very good superhero name...
: So, nicknames aside, I’m glad to see you two are getting along.
: Dude, same! Sana and I have like, a zillion things in common. Who would have ever thought?
: Wow. How close have the two of you gotten over the last few weeks?
: Rin let me touch her skulls.
: I did! No one’s ever asked to do that before.
: Even Futaba is like “Umm...can you turn those away when I’m trying to sleep?”
: I basically have to give her a friggin’ pep talk every night. But Sana here just walked up to them and started doing the Hamlet thing.
: She...spontaneously recited a monologue to a skull?
: Um...that part...didn’t happen.
: I kind of just...held one for a little while.
: Oh, right. Totally misremembered that scene in my head. Whoops.
: But yeah, Sana’s basically like a little sister to me already. Which is cool cause I’m kind of like Futaba’s little sister.
: So the three of us are gonna form a sisterhood and start sharing pants or however that one story goes.
I glance at Sana, who seems content but still struggling to keep up with Rin’s, uhh, pace.
Having known the two of them for some time now, I can see how they’d get along so well, but I can also see how it might be difficult at times.
Rin is adept when it comes to communicating with people, but lacks a filter.
And, of course, Sana is the complete opposite.
But either way, I’m glad to see the two of them spending time together like this.
: Um...I don’t know much about...sharing pants...but I am really happy to have another friend now.
: Ayane is...still a little too much for me sometimes...
: Oooooh, I totally forgot you two were even roommates! I don’t really talk to Ayane that much.
: What’s she like? That sword she brought in the other day was really cool. Do you think she’d let me hold it?
: Um...I don’t really know if she’d let you hold it...but she’s really nice.
: She was willing to get to know me when nobody else was so...I’m really thankful for her.
: Dude, everyone is willing to get to know you. You’ve just gotta put in some of the work.
: People are like, totally weird and annoying and stuff, but no one is gonna see you and be like “Nahh I’m good.”
: You’ve just gotta do the thing and then stuff will happen.
: Umm...can you...
: You need me to translate for you?
: Yes please...
: Wait...did I say something weird? What part about that was confusing?
: I think Rin is trying to say that everyone would be open to being your friend because of how cute you are.
: Yeah! That! That’s much easier to understand than how I put it!
: Wh-what?!
: Sana, you probably don’t realize this since you’re like, super shy and awkward and stuff, but you’re low-key one of the cutest girls in the entire world.
: Kind of like a cross between a lost kitten and an excited puppy. Oh- and like, four baby seals thrown into the mix.
: That’s too many things! I’m just a girl!
: Yeah but girls are the best! There’s a reason I’m so into-
: Ah-!
Uh-oh.
: Huh?
: Into what?
: Umm...uhh...
: Makeup! I’m really into makeup! Because...it looks better on girls than it looks on boys!
: Oh...umm...I see...
: Pah...
Rin suddenly deflates as she narrowly avoids revealing to her new friend that she’s [[probably] sexually attracted to her.
I can only imagine how finding out something like that would impact Sana, who I’m pretty sure is at least six-hundred years away from becoming curious about romance.
: Sensei...I, um...
: I want to...thank you again for...all of your help.
: Without you...I wouldn’t be able to-
: Don’t thank me yet, Sana. Your character arc has barely even started.
: My...what?
: I told you in class the other day. We can’t call it quits on your progression until you’re friends with everyone.
: Don’t make it sound like doubling your previous count of just one friend is enough to satisfy me.
: But two is already hard! Look at Rin! She deflated and I don’t even understand why!
: That...is something you’ll have to find out later. I’m not really able to disclose other peoples’ secrets to you.
: Secrets?! I don’t have any secrets! You take that back, Tall Guy!
: How am I back to that nickname already? I thought we were done with this.
: We were until you decided to hint at my...thoughts to Sana! She is too pure for such things!
: Um...are you...keeping a secret from me?
: I don’t have the most...experience...when it comes to friends...but you don’t have to hide anything...
: I’ll accept you no matter what...
: Look what you did.
: How is this my fault?
: I don’t know. But it is.
: That seems a little unfair, don’t you think?
: I think I’m going to chop your arms off the next time we’re alone together.
: Um...excuse me...
: I don’t really...understand what’s going on right now...
: But I’d like it if...you two would stop fighting...
: Ah- We’re not fighting! We’re just doing that thing where we, uhh, play-fight because we’re so close!
: You are?...
: Yeah!
: Um...I’m sorry if this is personal but...would you mind explaining...how close you are?
: Just so I can...better understand the relationship...between you two...
Rin stares again, expecting me to be the one to answer this question.
Thankfully, I have the perfect response for a time like this.
: Ahem...
: We are homies.
: We're bros.
: Sensei...
: You’re...what?
: And on that note, I will take my leave.
: Good day, huma-
: Uhh...girls. Good day, girls.
I slowly back away from the table and begin to make my way toward the bus stop to head home.
: What’s a “homie?”
: Why did he call you a...bro?
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
